annotations.title: Connect a public dataset to my workspace

description: Connects one public dataset to the authenticated workspace so its tables become queryable and downloadable. This is the gate every keyed read passes. Example: {"dataset_slug": "kden-metar-hourly"}. Idempotent: connecting an already-connected dataset succeeds and reports already_connected. Requires the Owner, Admin or Editor role. This is the one tool an mr_use_ key CANNOT call — that key class is read-only. It needs an OAuth connection carrying datasets:use, and refuses with the two routes that do work. It grants the workspace read access; it does not change the dataset or cost anything.
name: connect_dataset
title: Connect a public dataset to my workspace
